items.period: Shang oracle-bone script tradition; source page associates this form with 小學堂 record 45.EC02 and 《甲骨文編》799 / 《合集》34479
items.caption: A modern redraw of a Shang oracle-script form recorded as 非; scholars disagree whether early forms suggest opposed figures, wings, or a relation to 北.
items.alt: Black line glyph on white showing a central vertical stroke with short strokes extending alternately to the left and right.
items.selection_reason: The file page gives a specific Sinica record attribution and reuse notice; its oracle-script style is relevant to the earliest reported graph forms and the competing formation analyses.
items.rights: CC0 1.0 / public-domain dedication as stated on the file page; the Commons page attributes its source glyph to 小學堂 and separately links the official rights notice.

limitations.text: This is a modern vector redraw of a historical script form, not an ancient artifact photograph; no visual inspection of underlying oracle-bone artifacts was performed.
The proposed origin is disputed, and the selected graphic alone cannot decide whether it depicts wings, opposed people, or another form.
